text: Steenbarger: no, the trigger carries no volume test, and my method would not add one. My position entry is the buy stop over yesterday's high (C27), taken mechanically (C31); confirmation is fund flow via my declared COM proxy subcomponents.flow.cmf, not break-day volume, and that figure is not in these files, so I cannot settle day_vol 0.51 for oneil and minervini. What my method answers with is the loss side (C20): D close_vs_swing_high_pct 0.13, and a daily close back below pivot_high is my exit (C14). SUPPORT; cmf below 0 would be my caution.
